items.name: 地鼠追踪远程
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first-pass enemy appearance concept for a third-person 3D action roguelike, to be reviewed before image-to-3D modeling.
Style: unmistakably CARTOON, colorful stylized 3D game character render. Chunky rounded forms, exaggerated readable proportions, simple hand-painted color blocks, soft cel shading, broad highlights, clean matte materials, charmingly mischievous enemy expression. Matches a bright stylized woodland game with rounded foliage and painterly rocks. Compact three-to-four-head proportions, sturdy bipedal anatomy, clearly separated arms and legs. Strong silhouette visible at small gameplay size. Not photorealistic, not gritty, not horror, not realistic anatomy, not detailed individual fur strands, not ornate realistic armor, not a collectible toy product.
Composition: ONE full-body character only, three-quarter front view at a nearly eye-level camera, feet completely visible, centered with comfortable margins, on a plain warm ivory studio background with a subtle soft grounding shadow. Clear readable hands and equipment, restrained neutral ready stance. Simple shapes suitable for later retopology and a humanoid skeleton. No scene, no UI, no labels, no text, no watermarks. This is a fresh design, do not base it on any existing player/enemy model.
Subject: a squat, bipedal cartoon mole ranged hunter. Short pear-shaped body, cocoa-brown fur represented by smooth large shapes, cream muzzle and belly, tiny rounded ears, a broad rounded pink-brown nose, small alert eyes and determined eyebrows. Big spade-shaped digging mitts with three broad blunt digging claws, short sturdy boots. A simple moss-green short vest with an ochre belt and a small seed pouch. Orange digging goggles sit above the eyes on its forehead. Holds a short chunky wooden seed launcher clearly identifiable as a ranged weapon, with a round acorn-like barrel and one simple brass band, held diagonally downward so it does not obscure the face or torso. The mole must look like it can dig underground and pop up to fire tracking seed shots. Cheerfully troublesome rather than cute plush, no firearm realism, no projectile or spell effects.
